claim: Bridges the gap between the frame rate the video model actually generated and the delivery fps. to_movie_fps is the honest fill; double and smooth invent motion that sands the deliberate on-2s and on-3s stepping off your animation, turning limited animation into soap-opera glide.
not_visual: Purely temporal - it exists only in the gaps between frames. A still cannot show the difference between native and interpolated motion, and the specific thing that matters here (whether interpolation smears the anime stepping into mush) is invisible in any single image. Needs a side-by-side clip at matched playback speed, ideally on a fast pan where the judder is most legible.
